commit.messageHeadline: feat(ui): preview ordinary external links on hover
fix(ui): scope the preview pointer cursor to its external link
fix(ui): exclude wizard sign-in actions from link previews
fix(ui): refresh hover previews with verified main repairs
fix(ui): regenerate hover boot manifest after main integration
